description.en: Meta MMS-300M multilingual CTC forced aligner (Wav2Vec2ForCTC) that aligns an exact transcript to mono/stereo audio and returns word timestamps. The checkpoint covers 1,130 languages, but this port's native text normalization supports Dutch (nl/nld) and English (en/eng) Latin script only; text_normalization=pre_romanized accepts caller-supplied ASCII romanization, and unsupported non-Latin input is rejected. Checkpoint license: CC-BY-NC-4.0; GGUF conversion is local-only, no public redistribution is approved.
description.zh: Meta MMS-300M 多语言 CTC 强制对齐器（Wav2Vec2ForCTC），将精确文本对齐到单/双声道音频并返回词级时间戳。检查点覆盖 1130 种语言，但本移植的原生文本归一化仅支持荷兰语（nl/nld）与英语（en/eng）拉丁字母；text_normalization=pre_romanized 可接受调用方提供的 ASCII 罗马化，不支持的非拉丁输入会被拒绝。检查点许可：CC-BY-NC-4.0；GGUF 转换仅限本地，未获准公开再分发。

language.en: Language code. Built-in normalization supports nl/nld and en/eng; pre_romanized accepts any nonempty code.
language.zh: 语言代码。内置标准化支持nl/nld和en/eng； pre_romanized 接受任何非空代码。

text_normalization.en: Transcript normalization mode; latin handles Dutch/English Latin script natively, pre_romanized trusts caller-supplied ASCII romanization.
text_normalization.zh: 转写归一化模式；latin 原生处理荷兰语/英语拉丁字母，pre_romanized 直接采用调用方提供的 ASCII 罗马化。

return_timestamps.en: Compatibility option; word timestamps are always returned, including when false.
return_timestamps.zh: 兼容性选项；始终返回单词时间戳，包括 false 时。

star_frequency.en: Placement of the virtual <star> CTC target between words (segment) or at transcript edges (edges); matches the reference default segment.
star_frequency.zh: 虚拟 <star> CTC 目标的位置：词间（segment）或转写边缘（edges）；默认与参考实现一致为 segment。

merge_threshold_sec.en: Close gaps at or below this threshold, rounded to alignment frames, by moving the later word start; word entries remain separate. Default 0.0 disables gap closure.
merge_threshold_sec.zh: 在该阈值以内（含）的间隔通过移动后一个词起点来闭合，按对齐帧舍入；词条仍保持独立。默认 0.0 关闭间隔闭合。

sizes.basis: size=tree@huggingface; hf_mirror=assumed; modelscope=files API; est_vram=size lower bound (no measurement)
